  {"operation":"letter_symbol","chain":"M (Virgo, Mater) + Bay (b = house, ay = eternal)","reading":"The maternal house of eternity within the circle","languages":["en","he"],"source":"generative","confidence":0.45},
  {"operation":"numerical","chain":"M=13, B=2; 13+2=15 → Heh (window, breath); Mandalay=13 letters total","reading":"The window of breath through the thirteenfold circle","languages":["en","he"],"source":"generative","confidence":0.4},
